Repair User Guide — Branch

Type 2: Not Under Warranty (Without Serial No.) — Tested OK (Centre Repair)

Source: Odoo Tour Recorder export — Tour/1D. Repair User Guide - Branch [ Not Under Warranty (Without Serial No ) - Tested Ok ].json

Scenario: The product's warranty period has expired and it has no serial number. The item is received at the branch and handled at the branch's Centre Repair. The technician finds that the item works (Tested OK) so no repair, parts, quotation or payment is needed; the task is marked done and the item is dispatched back to the customer.
Every screenshot below is a real capture from a single, clean, fully-passing automated run — taken before each step's action, with the element to use framed in red.

1. Overview

This manual explains how to register and complete a branch (Centre Repair) repair for an out-of-warranty product with no serial number when the technician finds the item Tested OK, from the Helpdesk ticket through to dispatch.

Ticket stages covered

New Diagnosis Repair Completed Handed Over to Customer

Before you start

  • You have access to the Helpdesk, Field Service and Inventory apps.
  • The active company (top bar) is Jinasena Agricultural Machinery (Pvt) Ltd.
  • The customer and product already exist in Odoo (Contacts and Product Master).
  • The item has been physically brought to the branch by the customer.

How to read each step

NavigationWhere you are in Odoo (app › menu › screen / dialog).
ActionWhat to click, select, or type.
DescriptionWhy the step is needed and what happens.
ScreenshotThe screen you are on right before performing the action, with the element to use framed in red.

Step summary

SectionStepsPurpose
A1–11Open Helpdesk, create the ticket, classify it (branch Centre Repair), and generate a temporary serial number.
B12–14Return the item into stock and validate the receipt.
C15–16Plan the intervention and create the Field Service task (no factory transfer for a Centre Repair).
D17–21Close and reopen the task, mark the item Tested OK and mark the task done.
E22–24Dispatch the item back to the customer, validate the transfer and finish.

Section A — Create the Repair Ticket (Steps 1–11)

1 Open the HelpDesk app
NavigationOdoo Home → Apps
ActionClick the Helpdesk app icon on the home screen.
DescriptionOpens the Helpdesk Overview dashboard, showing every support team you have access to.
Odoo Apps home screen — Helpdesk app icon
2 Open the repair tickets
NavigationHelpdesk → Overview → Customer Care - Repair
ActionOn the Customer Care - Repair team card, click Tickets.
DescriptionOpens the list of repair tickets already created for the team.
Helpdesk Overview — Tickets button on the Customer Care - Repair team card
3 Create a new ticket
NavigationHelpdesk → Customer Care - Repair (Tickets)
ActionClick New at the top-left of the ticket list.
DescriptionOpens a blank Helpdesk ticket form for the repair item received from the customer.
All Tickets list — New button
4 Assign the ticket to yourself
NavigationNew ticket form
ActionClick Assign to Me in the status bar.
DescriptionSaves the ticket for the first time and assigns it to the current user. This also generates the ticket's sequence-based name (e.g. REPAIR/2026/01609) — the ticket has no user-editable title.
Blank new ticket form — Assign to Me button
5 Set the repair Type
NavigationTicket form → Type field
ActionClick the Type field and select Repair - Not Under Warranty (Without Serial No.).
DescriptionClassifies items whose warranty has expired and that have no serial number. The field lists the repair types configured in Studio.
Ticket form — Type field
6 Set the Return Receipt Location
NavigationTicket form → Return Receipt Location field
ActionClick Return Receipt Location and select the branch receiving the item (e.g. BR-AM/Stock, Jinasena Ampara Branch).
DescriptionThe location where the item is received for repair at the branch.
Ticket form — Return Receipt Location field
7 Select the Repair Reason
NavigationTicket form → Repair Reason field
ActionClick Repair Reason and select the reported fault (e.g. Low Pressue).
DescriptionChoose the common error that best matches the customer's complaint. This is a tags field; at least one reason is required before the item can be returned. (The reason is spelled Low Pressue in the Odoo configuration.)
Ticket form — Repair Reason field
8 Select the Job Location
NavigationTicket form → Job Location field
ActionIn Job Location, select Centre Repair.
DescriptionDefines where the repair is performed. Centre Repair keeps the work at the branch's service centre, so the item does not travel to the factory (no Send to Factory / Send to Sales Centre steps).
Ticket form — Job Location field
9 Select the Customer
NavigationTicket form → Customer field
ActionClick Customer and select KURUNEGALA CASH CUSTOMER.
DescriptionEmail and Phone are filled automatically from the customer record.
Ticket form — Customer field
10 Select the Product
NavigationTicket form → Product field
ActionClick Product and select [JMC6] Multi Chopper 6Hp (Tractor Type).
DescriptionThe repair item from the Product Master. Once Customer, Product and Repair Reason are set, the Create Serial No button appears.
Ticket form — Product field
11 Create a temporary serial number
NavigationTicket form → status bar
ActionClick Create Serial No.
DescriptionThis repair type has no manufacturer serial number, so the system generates a temporary one (equal to the ticket number). Save the ticket first if it has pending changes.
Ticket form — Create Serial No button

Section B — Receive the Item (Steps 12–14)

12 Return — receive the item
NavigationTicket form → status bar
ActionClick Return.
DescriptionRecords the item being physically received from the customer by creating a Returned Picking (e.g. BR-AM/RET/00766) in the Ready state.
Ticket form — Return button
13 Validate the receipt
NavigationReturned Picking → status bar
ActionClick Validate.
DescriptionConfirms the item has arrived into the repair stock location. The ticket cannot move on until this picking is Done.
Returned Picking (Ready) — Validate button
14 Close
NavigationReturned Picking (Done)
ActionClick Close to return to the ticket.
DescriptionThe receipt is Done. Returning to the ticket, the Plan Intervention button is now available.
Returned Picking (Done) — Close

Section C — Plan the Repair Task (Steps 15–16)

15 Plan Intervention
NavigationTicket form → status bar
ActionClick Plan Intervention.
DescriptionAssigns the work to a repair technician. Because the Job Location is Centre Repair, the ticket goes straight to planning at the branch — there is no Send to Factory / Received at Factory leg.
Ticket form — Plan Intervention button
16 Create & View Task
NavigationCreate a Field Service task dialog
ActionClick Create & View Task.
DescriptionCreates the Field Service task and opens it, where the technician records the diagnosis, photo and parts.
Create a Field Service task dialog — Create & View Task button

Section D — Tested OK and Complete the Task (Steps 17–21)

17 Close the task dialog
NavigationTask dialog → header
ActionClick Close (the X in the top-right corner).
DescriptionThe new task is created and linked to the ticket. Close the dialog to return to the ticket; the task is reopened from the ticket in the next step. (If the grey Add Data reminders about diagnosis and image are on screen, dismiss them first.)
Task dialog — Close button
18 Open the task from the ticket
NavigationTicket form → button box
ActionClick Tasks.
DescriptionOpens the repair task linked to this ticket.
Ticket form — Tasks button
19 Tested OK
NavigationTask dialog → header
ActionClick Tested OK.
DescriptionUse this when the technician finds the item works and needs no repair. It skips the diagnosis, parts, quotation and payment steps of the full flow (the Add Data reminders about diagnosis and image can be ignored).
Task dialog — Tested OK button
20 Mark as done
NavigationTask dialog → header
ActionClick Mark as done.
DescriptionCloses the work on the task; the ticket moves to Repair Completed.
Task dialog — Mark as done button
21 Close the task
NavigationTask dialog (done)
ActionClick Close to go back to the ticket.
DescriptionThe task now shows a green done check. Closing the dialog returns to the ticket, where the Dispatch button is available.
Task dialog (done) — Close button

Section E — Dispatch to the Customer (Steps 22–24)

22 Dispatch
NavigationTicket form → status bar
ActionClick Dispatch.
DescriptionProcesses the completed repair item back to the customer. Because this is a Centre Repair, the item goes straight back to the customer from the branch — there is no Send to / Received at Sales Centre leg. (The button can take a moment to appear; refresh the page if it is not shown.)
Ticket form — Dispatch button
23 Validate the dispatch
NavigationTransfer dialog → header
ActionClick Validate.
DescriptionCompletes the outgoing transfer of the repaired item to the customer.
Transfer dialog (Ready) — Validate button
24 Close
NavigationTransfer dialog (Done)
ActionClick Close to go to the ticket view.
DescriptionThe transfer is Done and the ticket is now in Handed Over to Customer — the repair is complete.
Transfer dialog (Done) — Close button
QA notes
  • Steps 1–16 are identical to the Branch "Full Flow" (1C) guide: Repair Reason Low Pressue, Job Location Centre Repair (no Send to / Received at Factory). From the task onward this guide follows the "Tested OK" ending of the Factory guide (1B) — but because this is a Centre Repair the item is dispatched straight from the branch (no Send to / Received at Sales Centre).
  • There is no quotation, deposit, delivery chain or balance payment in this flow — the technician marks the item Tested OK and the item is returned as is.
  • The Return button (fix_repair_action_direct_return) raises "You may only return Done pickings" server-side but still creates the Returned Picking first. The automated run calls it, swallows the error, then validates the resulting picking via /web/dataset/call_kw (the Validate button is hidden/unreliable under the Studio views).
  • The last two recorded tour steps (a Vendor Group dropdown and one of its entries) could not be reproduced: the Vendor Group field does not exist on the Helpdesk ticket (it exists only on Contacts and Users, and is not shown on this customer's Contact form), so they are treated as recorder artefacts and have no screenshot. Please confirm with the tour author where this field was meant to be used.
  • In the recorded tour, the task is closed (step 17) and reopened from the ticket (step 18) before Tested OK; the guide follows that order. Dispatch becomes visible only after the task is done and the page has fully refreshed, so the automated flow reloads in a polling loop.
  • Each screenshot is captured immediately before the step's action with the target element framed in red (a temporary CSS outline applied to the live element only for the capture). Screenshots come from one clean, fully-passing automated run (admin role) against the staging instance.
  • The staging database is a temporary Odoo.sh environment, automatically deleted on 12 October 2026; regenerate the screenshots on the production instance if needed.
